meta.workDescription: The CSS (Commander Support Staff) and the Command Team (Commander, Chief Deputy & Shirt) are located within Building 1156 and the UTM (Unit Training Manager), USR (Unit Safety Representative) & VCO (Vehicle Control Officer) are in Building 1146. All three sections work within an ‘Admin Building’ but fall under the same section for this JSTO.

meta.evacuation:
In Case of a Fire - Think "SPEED"
Sound the alarm or yell "FIRE FIRE FIRE"
Phone the Fire Department 
Evacuate the building and meet up in the parking lot of building 1156
Extinguish the fire if possible 
Direct firefighters to the fire
